eyebrow: A specific control for each technique

steps.label: Unique local admin passwords + Credential Guard
steps.sub: Closes pass-the-hash — one dumped hash, worthless elsewhere

steps.label: Continuous access evaluation, shorter token life
steps.sub: Closes token theft — stolen proof stops being proof

steps.label: Credential tiering + Privileged Access Workstations
steps.sub: Keeps admin credentials off everyday, commonly compromised devices

eyebrow: Match the control to the technique
code:
Pass-the-hash        -> unique per-machine local admin + Credential Guard
Token/ticket theft    -> continuous access evaluation + device binding
Shared admin creds    -> credential tiering (Tier 0/1/2) + PAWs
Flat-network movement -> micro-segmentation (Chapter 3)
caption: No single tool stops lateral movement — each control closes one specific path.
